plan.title: Single-stage RFQ mandatory terms block partial acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: in the Terms & Conditions drawer, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", confirm both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and return to the single-stage create screen

steps.note: Configure the two event terms and mark all terms mandatory; this buyer-side configuration has no dedicated domain step.
Invite one QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor can see the terms block.
Accept exactly one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to submit the quote and assert that submission is blocked because the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
